title: This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below 2^{-57} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the degree-10 Taylor sum of `exp(361)` equals `38657793315667161768372101/3628800`, which is strictly greater than `2^{57}*(319/100) = 11493186249049505792/25`.
- The degree-9 partial sum is strictly below that target, and the next Taylor term is positive, so `(319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-57}`. This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below that majorant, hence strictly below `2^{-57}`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is the case `C=3` on one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
- The parent commit is #4367. This pull request adds `research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c3` and replays that predecessor.
